name: CheckboxGroup
description:
Several related checkboxes sharing one value array. A checkbox with `parent` ticks or
clears the rest and shows the mixed state when only some are ticked (pass `allValues`).
signature: ({ legend, orientation, tone, className, children, ...rest }: CheckboxGroupProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group (rendered as a fieldset legend in the field-label style).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of layout and keyboard navigation.

props.name: tone
props.description: Tone for every checkbox in the group.

props.name: allValues
props.description: Names of all checkboxes in the group. Use this when creating a parent checkbox.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Names of the checkboxes in the group that should be initially ticked.

To render a controlled checkbox group, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Event handler called when a checkbox in the group is ticked or unticked.
Provides the new value as an argument.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description:
Names of the checkboxes in the group that should be ticked.

To render an uncontrolled checkbox group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.
